_about: One-off service changes applied after the calendar: detours, closed stops, cancelled lines, alerts. Each entry needs from/to (inclusive ISO dates), kind, message and source. kinds: alert (message only), cancel_line (line_id not served), close_stop (stop_id not boardable/alightable). Example: {"from": "2026-11-07", "to": "2026-11-07", "kind": "cancel_line", "line": "de", "message": "Downtown Express cancelled Saturday night", "source": "https://occtransport.org/news.html"}
